Class AlgoAlertReason

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoAlertReason
public final class AlgoAlertReason extends Object
NLS keys persisted in algo_alert_evaluation_state.reason. The alert diagnostics dialog translates the column value, so every fixed reason is stored as a key of the application message bundle. Free text, such as the message of an unexpected exception, is shown untranslated.
